pairs.evidence: src/components/guide/GuideMarkdown.tsx:14 The guide's markdown goes from a line-split parse straight to React nodes, and none of the 12 block components compiles to an instruction stream or runs one; a search of src/components/guide (and all of src/) for bytecode, opcode, interpreter, coroutine and register file found no hits, so this subject's precondition (a bytecode compiler/interpreter) does not hold.
